name: io.github.yeick010/italycheck
title: ItalyCheck
description: Italian public bodies by codice fiscale (IndicePA): name, PEC, address. Paid per call via x402.

tools.name: check_partita_iva_format
tools.description: Free offline check of an Italian partita IVA (11 digits + check digit). Does not confirm registration.

tools.name: lookup_italian_pa
tools.description: Look up an Italian public administration or public-service operator by 11-digit codice fiscale in IndicePA (AgID). Use when an agent must verify a public-sector counterparty, find its official PEC (certified email) addresses, or confirm it exists before e-invoicing. Costs $0.005 in USDC (or 0.005 EURC) on Base via x402.

tools.name: verify_italian_counterparty
tools.description: Verify an Italian counterparty in one call before invoicing or paying: partita IVA / codice fiscale check digit, IndicePA public-administration record (name, category, institutional PEC, address) and the e-invoicing offices that receive FatturaPA via SDI (codice univoco ufficio, start date, PEC). Returns verdict pa_verificata | formato_valido_non_verificato | formato_non_valido with sources and CC BY 4.0 attribution. Public-administration data only: private companies are not confirmed (no VIES, no company PEC). Malformed input, a wrong check digit or an IndicePA outage are not charged. Costs $0.01 in USDC (or 0.01 EURC) on Base via x402.

id.description: Italian partita IVA or numeric codice fiscale (11 digits, optional IT prefix), e.g. 80016350821
